title: Add BlueFire logo to header navigation, hero section, and footer

requirements.text: Add the BlueFire logo (shield with blue flames and red network nodes) to the header navigation area in the top-left corner at medium size, positioned next to or above the company name text 'BlueFire'

quotes: 2.-debe aparecer junto al texto de nombre de la empresa

acceptanceCriteria: Logo appears in the header/navigation area
Logo is positioned in the top-left corner
Logo size is medium (appropriate for navigation bar)
Logo appears alongside the 'BlueFire' text, not replacing it

requirements.text: Add the BlueFire logo to the hero section alongside the company name 'BlueFire' at medium size, ensuring it complements the existing hero layout and maintains visual hierarchy

quotes: 2.-debe aparecer junto al texto de nombre de la empresa

acceptanceCriteria: Logo appears in the hero section
Logo is placed next to the 'BlueFire' company name text
Logo size is medium and proportionate to hero section typography
Logo maintains visual balance with existing hero content (tagline, CTAs, statistics)

requirements.text: Add the BlueFire logo to the footer section at medium size alongside the company name, ensuring consistent branding across all page sections

quotes: 2.-debe aparecer junto al texto de nombre de la empresa

acceptanceCriteria: Logo appears in the footer section
Logo is placed next to the 'BlueFire' text in the footer
Logo size is medium and consistent with other footer elements
Logo maintains visual consistency with header and hero placements

requirements.text: Render the BlueFire logo as a static asset from frontend/public/assets/generated using the uploaded logo image files (file_00000000e32471fd987536c27237c5ae.png)
acceptanceCriteria: Logo image is saved as a static asset in frontend/public/assets/generated directory
Logo is referenced consistently across header, hero, and footer components
Logo loads efficiently without external dependencies
Logo maintains transparent background and original quality

constraints: Logo must appear alongside the company name text, not replace it
Logo size must be medium across all three locations
Logo must be rendered as a static asset from frontend/public/assets/generated
nonGoals: Creating animated or interactive logo variations
Implementing logo click interactions or navigation behavior
Adding logo variants for different screen sizes beyond responsive sizing
Replacing the company name text with logo-only branding
